verdict.rationale: Agent Operating Procedures let teams define agent behavior in natural language, "the same way you train human agents with SOPs," which implies scripted multi-step workflows rather than single canned answers. Email is described as handling "complex customer threads," and Duet-generated tests cover "diverse pathways." All of this is vendor-claimed and only implies troubleshooting flows; nothing explicitly documents clarifying questions or adaptive branching. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the agent asks clarifying questions, documented multi-step troubleshooting or branching examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of resolution quality.
